fields.statement: At f5b15eab, go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestWatchdogCIRerun -count=1 -v passed. The test fakes the gh-backed deps (ci reads head, checks and Actions run attempts; rerun records gh run rerun --failed calls) and shows: a red head's failed run 7 rerun once; still red at attempt 2 gives no second rerun and no resume; once green the run is resumed with --retry exactly once (two polls, one resume, one log line per action); a fresh red head whose run is already at attempt 2 is not rerun; a new head bbbb222 gets its own rerun. Read the diff: watchdogCIRerun only acts on ended, failed, non-live, autonomous runs whose failed step runs or waits on rhiza ship check (not --pr-open/--main), records CIHead before rerunning, and charges the resume to the watchdog budget; the live path reads gh pr view and gh run list --commit <head> --json databaseId,attempt. All TestWatchdog* tests and go vet on internal/api and internal/daemon pass.
